name: Carbon Based Mobile Menu
author: carbonbasedstudio

sections.description:
Carbon Based Mobile Menu adds a fixed bottom bar and a slide-out menu for phones.

Features

  • Bottom bar – Fixed bar for primary actions (Home, Menu, optional Search, Cart).
  • Slide-out menu – Left panel for full site navigation, with expandable submenus.
  • Product search – Optional search from the bottom bar. When WooCommerce is active, search is limited to products.
  • Header image – Optional mobile header image with configurable height and link.

Settings are under Carbon Based > Mobile Menu. WooCommerce is optional.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the carbon-based-mobile-menu folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate Carbon Based Mobile Menu.
  3. Configure settings under Carbon Based > Mobile Menu.
  4. Assign the bottom bar and left slide-out menus on those settings tabs (or under Appearance > Menus). Add and reorder items under Appearance > Menus. Pick bottom-bar icons on the Mobile tab.
sections.faq:
Who is this for?

  • Sites that want a bottom bar and slide-out menu on phones.
  • Stores that want product search in that bar when WooCommerce is active.

User guide

Setup and menu placement are covered in the Mobile Menu user guide.
